modmenu.descriptionTranslation.begleiter: A craftable companion that plays Minecraft like a second player: follows orders, gathers, mines, crafts, builds farms and schematics, remembers the world and can progress on its own.
gui.begleiter.duties.heading: What should I do?
gui.begleiter.duties.free.tooltip: I play by myself: wood, tools, a house, ores - everything a player would do.
gui.begleiter.duties.follow.tooltip: I stay close to you and help in fights.
gui.begleiter.duties.stay.tooltip: I wait exactly here until you call me again.
gui.begleiter.duties.farm.tooltip: I stay at the field (near you or at the storage), harvest ripe crops, replant and bring full pockets to the storage.
gui.begleiter.duties.animals.tooltip: I stay with the animals here, feed pairs to breed them (up to 12 per kind) and pick up eggs and feathers. Give me the right food.
gui.begleiter.duties.trade.tooltip: I stay in the village and regularly sell my surplus for emeralds.

gui.begleiter.build.movement.tooltip: How the companion moves while building. Walk: on foot like a survival player. Fly: flies to high or hard-to-reach spots. Teleport: flies, and jumps straight there on long trips (over 16 blocks) or when stuck. Ghost: flies through everything and places blocks instantly. Click to switch.

server.begleiter.blueprint.zuckerrohrfar: Grows naturally; observers trigger the pistons. Collection chest in the front-left recess. Some drops can remain on the base plants.
server.begleiter.blueprint.bambusfarm.he: Observers harvest grown bamboo; water carries drops to the front-left chest. Some drops can remain on the base plants.
server.begleiter.blueprint.wasserernte.h: Put one water bucket in the dispenser. Rear button: harvest; press again to retrieve water. Replant by hand or ask the companion. Chest at the front left.
server.begleiter.blueprint.schmelzofen.h: Input in the top chest, fuel in the left chest. Finished products in the front chest; lamp indicates output chest contents.
server.begleiter.blueprint.komposter.hel: Compostable leftovers in the top chest. Bone meal collects on the right; lamp indicates compost level.
Put a water bucket in the dispenser. Rear button harvests; press again to retrieve water. Replant carrots afterwards. Collection chest at front left.
server.begleiter.blueprint.kartoffelfarm: Put a water bucket in the dispenser. Rear button harvests; press again to retrieve water. Replant potatoes afterwards. Collection chest at front left.
server.begleiter.blueprint.kaktusfarm.he: Nine cacti grow against fences and harvest automatically. Water collects drops at the front left. Some drops are lost on the cactus.
Raw food at the top, fuel in the left chest. Cooked food collects in front. Accepts smoking recipes only.
server.begleiter.blueprint.hochofen.name: Automatic blast furnace
server.begleiter.blueprint.hochofen.help: Ores or smeltable metal items at the top, fuel on the left. Metal output in front; lamp indicates contents.
server.begleiter.blueprint.schaltlager.h: Input at the top, output on the right. Lever on locks transport; lever off releases it. Starts locked.
Put supplies in the top chest. Each button press sends exactly one item to the right chest. Without a button press, supplies stay in the dropper.
server.begleiter.blueprint.itemsortierer: Set up the middle hopper (filter): 18× the target item in the first slot, one item that never passes through (ideally renamed) in each of the other four. Put mixed items in the top chest: target items end up at the bottom front, everything else on the right. The most recent target item waits in the bottom hopper until the next one arrives.
server.begleiter.blueprint.lichtschalter: One button at each end of the hallway. Each press toggles the light, from either end. The copper bulb in the middle remembers the state.
server.begleiter.blueprint.tresorschloss: Three levers in front of the iron door. It only opens with levers 1 and 3 on and lever 2 off. Any other setting keeps it shut.
server.begleiter.blueprint.bruchsteingen: Lava flows along the channel onto water and turns into cobblestone. Mine the middle block and it forms again right away. The water drops into a hole and never reaches the lava, so no obsidian forms.
